summary: KEEP. Acceptance ① (no direct PluginProcess child): every launch freezes and validates a HarnessSpawnPlan into a real supervisor SpawnSpec before anything exists; Windows creates the child suspended inside a creation-time kill-on-close job, proves the membership while the child cannot execute, persists identity and Running, and only then resumes (resume IS the first instruction, and a failed proof sweeps a never-started process); Linux sets process_group(0) pre-exec so group leadership exists from the first instruction and refuses unproven launches with a killpg sweep; macOS creates nothing at all after this round's pre-spawn refusal. The launch deliberately does not go through ProcessSupervisor::start_with_write_profile — the supervisor's only backend is the deterministic fake, so routing through it would be strictly weaker than the real guardian primitive, and the supervisor's paged-drain output model does not match the transport's NDJSON pump; what the transport reuses is the supervisor's own vocabulary and order (SpawnSpec validation, SupervisorJournal compare_and_swap, the full phase ladder, replayed-identity refusal, Quarantined on unproven sweeps), which is recorded as the open_question's otherwise-branch answer; a real ProcessTreeBackend for Windows stays the O-GATE follow-up. Acceptance ② (Mac Native only under a proven no-fork/no-exec single-process profile): holds fail-closed — the undeclared third-party harness is refused pre-spawn with the SafeDisabled vocabulary, the unactivated declared one likewise, and after this round even a bound Activated report cannot conjure a containment, so no macOS harness child is ever created; the enforcement direction (apply the built P18 profile at spawn and prove the single leader) is NOT implemented and is the task's disclosed limit — vacuous-only satisfaction is stated plainly, not dressed up. Acceptance ③ (completion follows full proof/drain): kill_confirmed sweeps the tree first, the record drains only on a proven-empty member list, an unproven sweep quarantines, and s23 proves the Drained terminal on Windows with an OS-side grandchild-death proof. Acceptance ④ (final Wave 3 HOST_API v1.3, explicit downgrade refusal): the catalog advertises WAVE3_HOST_API (1,3), the install gate refuses a single-process package below the floor at install time naming the package and the floor while additive 1.0/1.1/1.2 packages stay installable, both crates' floor constants are pinned equal, and the version pins the advance legitimately retired (s03, s19a) were migrated with their original judgment strength. Honest disclosures: rpc::HOST_API_VERSION remains the transitional (1,2) with no production consumer (manifest.rs documents the state; advancing it and its pin is a follow-up); the harness tree journal is the in-memory deterministic journal (store-backed persistence is P25's scope) while the containment itself survives daemon death on Windows via the kill-on-close job; a Unix daemon crash between spawn and identity persistence leaves a bounded self-grouped orphan window (recovery scanning is P27's scope); the Linux grandchild e2e and the entire macOS arm are certified by native CI, not by this host.
